items.title: DMart Q1 results: Cons PAT up 11% to Rs 860 crore, revenue rises to Rs 18,795 crore
items.description: Avenue Supermarts reported an 11.3% net profit increase for the June quarter.  The company's revenue from operations also saw a 14.9% year-on-year rise.  EBITDA grew by 15.4% compared to the same period last year.  The retailer's EBITDA margin showed a slight improvement to 8%.  These financial results reflect the company's performance in the recent past.
